result.explanation: The detector shows H1 (pressure after the separator) is dramatically below normal while TP2 (compressor outlet) is elevated during loading, and duty cycle is pinned at 100%. This is the classic separator/filter restriction signature: a blocked separator raises outlet pressure while starving downstream pressure the compressor keeps loading. The elevated DV_pressure is secondary to the overall system being under pressure/strain.
result.likely_cause: Separator/cyclonic filter element restriction (blockage), causing pressure drop across the separator
checks: Compare H1 vs TP3 gap while loading; restriction confirmed if the drop exceeds 0.5 bar

Monitor oil temperature for rise above 75°C

Duty cycle is at 100% because the compressor never reaches cut-out, and DV_pressure is abnormally high (z=13.4), which separately points to a dryer tower/purge valve fault. The pattern is a combination of restriction and dryer-signal anomalies rather than a single clean fault.
result.likely_cause: Separator/cyclonic filter element restriction (with a concurrent dryer tower/purge valve anomaly indicated by the elevated DV_pressure)

Inspect and if needed replace the separator element / cyclonic filter.
Check the dryer purge valve and tower solenoid switching, and look for DV_pressure spikes outside normal tower changeover.
Check for oil carry-over and oil temperature trend.
Verify tower alternation signal and moisture in the outlet lines.
